summary: Per-object audio-processing dispatch. For each descriptor in the array at this+0xC4, selects a processing routine from the mode field: AudioSampleLookup (1), AudioFIRConvolutionFilter (2), FixedPointIDCT (4), or, for mode 8, a render-variant branch (RenderModeBranch, AudioMixing, or RenderingBranchOnDAT005d79dc selected by this+0x44). Writes the chosen routine pointer to the per-object output slot and, when the element flag permits and the stored mode differs, transforms the source buffer into the destination (plain word copy, FIR-style fixed-point pass, or double-precision convolution). Unsupported modes raise errors 6 and 47 through the error object.

operations.description: Skip processing entirely when the object count at this+0x20 is zero or negative.
Load the dispatch state from this+0x198 and the per-object mode field at this+0xE8.
Iterate the descriptor array at this+0xC4, stepping 84 bytes per object.
Mode not 8 (and not 1/2/4): write error code 6 and the offending mode to obj+0x14 and obj+0x18, then dispatch through the obj vtable.

Mode 8 branches on this+0x44: zero selects RenderingBranchOnDAT005d79dc with counter 0, 1 selects RenderModeBranch with counter 1, 2 selects AudioMixing with counter 2, otherwise writes error code 47.
Write the selected routine pointer to the per-object output slot.
If the flag byte at this+0xF4 is set and the stored mode at this+0x1C4 differs from the selected counter, run the buffer transformation.

Counter 1: FIR-style fixed-point pass accumulating (word * word + 2048) >> 12 into 16-bit destinations, using source and destination pointers from this+0x110 and this+0x114, bounded by word_5B0588 with unk_5B0508 as the base.
Counter 2: double-precision convolution accumulating scaled products of unsigned 16-bit source values against the dbl_5B05C8 coefficient tables into float destinations, bounded by dbl_5B05C8.
Counter 0: plain word copy of 64 words from the source pointer (this+0x110) to the destination pointer (this+0x114).
Return after all objects are processed.

transform(src, dst, counter); // copy | fixed-point | double-convolution
